name: Eyvor
title: Netkeeper of the Cold Quay
examine: Salmon under the ice shelf, weather in her knee, and a strict personal treaty with the Darkwater: she does not go out on it, and it does not come in for her.
lines: The run is under the shelf. The fish do not know it is winter.
I fish the gray water. Nobody fishes the dark one.
My knee says three days of weather. My knee has never lied.
